name: Dutiful Steps
summary: Caretaker Alaric asks you to carry tomb dust from the Stromgarde Keep crypt to the sea. The rite renews a cycle of remembrance for the fallen.

sections.title: Toward the Sea
sections.body: Your way back to the sunlit world begins with a small satchel. Caretaker Alaric asks you to take it to the cliffs behind Stromgarde Keep and cast its contents into the Great Sea. The dust comes from the tomb below the keep, where its guardians preserve ceremonial rites for honoring the fallen. Each season, some is spread across Azeroth’s oceans as a symbolic renewal.

faq.q: Who is asking me to carry the dust?
faq.answer: Caretaker Alaric asks you to carry the tomb dust from the Stromgarde Keep crypt to the sea.
The satchel holds dust from the tomb beneath Stromgarde Keep.

faq.q: Why is the tomb dust spread across the sea?
aliases: why throw dust in the ocean
faq.answer: Each season, some tomb dust is spread across Azeroth’s oceans as a symbolic act of renewing cycles.

faq.q: Where am I meant to cast the satchel?
faq.answer: Caretaker Alaric asks you to cast the tomb dust into the Great Sea from the cliffs behind Stromgarde Keep.

faq.q: What do the tomb’s guardians preserve?
faq.answer: The tomb’s guardians preserve knowledge of ceremonial rites used to honor the fallen.
